role.altitude: The floor layer keeps reading the room, judging where people walk and where seams will hold and hide; measuring with a tape, sketching by hand and working out roll layouts on paper shrink a little.
skills_to_grow: Using a laser measure with a room sketch app
role.ambitious_version: A floor layer who leaves the survey with an exact cutting plan and less waste.

tasks.short: Measure the room, walk it to determine traffic areas, decide location of seams, and draw the cutting plan and mark the seams.

steps.what: Floor layer measures the room and notes doorways, columns and fixed objects
Floor layer walks the room to determine traffic areas, entrances and light direction
Floor layer decides the location of seams away from traffic areas and in line with the light
Floor layer draws the cutting plan with roll lengths and marks the seams on the floor

tasks.design: A laser distance meter sends measurements to a room sketch app on the phone, instead of noting tape readings and drawing by hand. Judging traffic areas and deciding seams stay with the floor layer on site. With the seams placed in the sketch, the app works out roll lengths, cuts and waste for the chosen roll width, and the floor layer still marks the seams on the floor by hand.
tasks.previous_blocker: Measurements and cutting plans were done with tape and paper.
tasks.enabler_now: Laser meters that send readings to room sketch apps with roll layout.
tasks.human_edge: Seeing where a seam will catch the light from the window.
tasks.altitude: Less measuring and sums; judging the room stays.

reach.learn: Whether exact cutting plans cut waste.

evidence.claim: Laser distance meters send readings to phone apps that draw room sketches and work out material layouts.

assumptions: Boundary: deciding seams and planning cuts; laying and seaming the floor are other tasks.
Judging traffic and deciding seams keep their full time.

incremental.description: Floor layer keeps roll widths and products in the app current.

time_saved_range_pct.basis: Low: irregular rooms measured by tape; high: standard rooms with the laser and app.

tasks.savings_basis: 100 focal-role baseline hours; external labour excluded; incremental focal work deducted once; provisional

job.title: Floor Layers, Except Carpet, Wood, and Hard Tiles
